title: The MCP bridge and the window have separate documents
text: Documents opened in the window with ui_open are invisible to doc_list, page_render and the other doc_* tools: the bridge has its own session. To render or edit a PDF through the MCP open it with doc_open path=<pdf> (a new document id), render with page_render {doc, page, dpi}, save with doc_save. ui_screenshot shows the window (it must be visible).
